'''Zizbisterling''' was a fictional [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Private/Legends|private]] that belonged to the [[Pop-Dogs]], a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] unit. She was mentioned by [[Wraith Squadron]] member [[Trey Courser]] to a guard as an excuse in order to enter the [[Major Saving's Army Surplus]] building.<ref name="MK" />
